Dcondo Reef Kathu

Condominium in Kathu
HomeSaleDcondo Reef Kathu

Project overview

Listed as Dcondo Reef Phuket, a large completed project by Sansiri in Kathu: four buildings of eight storeys with 706 apartments on a site of about 12,800 sqm, finished in September 2024.

Advertised resale units are studios of about 28 sqm, one-bedroom apartments of 24-34 sqm and two-bedroom apartments of around 50-52 sqm. The project has a communal pool, gym, co-working space, garden, reception and EV charging, with parking for about 40% of units.

Tesco Lotus Kathu is about 2 km away and Phuket International Airport about 32 km. Unit counts differ by source (Hipflat shows 161), so the portal figure of 706 is used.

Dcondo Reef Kathu: key facts

  • Dcondo Reef Kathu is a condominium in Kathu, Phuket, developed by Sansiri.
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 24–52 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Sep 2024.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿2,450,000.
  • Nearest beach: Patong Beach (~7 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Central Phuket shopping mall (~3.5 km); Prince of Songkla University, Phuket Campus (~2.6 km); Bangkok Hospital Phuket (5-10 minutes); Andamanda Phuket waterpark (10-15 minutes).
  • More projects by Sansiri in our catalogue: BRISA Patong by Sansiri, The Base Cherngtalay, The Tales Story One - Bangjo.
